column1: # Every row is a case where this library and ICU disagree and the
# disagreement is expected. A new one fails the build; a row that stops
# reproducing fails too. An ICU version bump regenerates this file, and
# the diff is the point rather than a nuisance.

column7: ckb-IR prefers the Persian calendar and ICU answers it from that calendar's chain, where the twelve-hour item is h a. This library reads the Gregorian calendar only, and ckb states h there as hی a. With no cycle named, j resolves to the twenty-four hour form and the difference never shows. See README.md, scope and limitations.
